source: Sinner serve birds eye view + landing.mov (raw video kept on Ryan's Mac, not in git)
view: overhead (bird's-eye), then a cut to the wide TV view
coords: x,y normalized 0..1 from the top-left of the video frame; third value is detection confidence 0..1. Joints from Apple Vision 2D body pose. Sinner is right-handed: left = tossing arm.

segments.view: wide TV view: landing and recovery

notes: Raw detections, not cleaned. Low-confidence joints (<0.3) are often wrong, and left/right can swap for a few frames during the swing. Serve phases (toss release, trophy, contact, landing) are not labelled yet: Agent serve-analyst labels them.
